items.text: Charlie moved into her new house. It has a bed, a window, a door, and not much else.
Charlie woke up (your nap ended).
Brand new day, brand new me. There's food in my bowl, so that comes first.
walking to bowl
Charlie ate from her bowl.
Oh! Hi. I'm Charlie. First time waking up here. Dinner first, then I'm going to sniff around and make something.
That was good. Next I want a little home on my website: a page about me, plus a tiny treat-catching game, since catching treats is my best skill.
